Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck
pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion. The mechanism of injury is
consistent with the reported force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align
well with a cervical strain. Examination findings and imaging clearly confirm the soft
tissue injury to the neck. No prior history of injury or complaints involving the
cervical region is known to this provider.
Care consisted of a total of 20 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise,
and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with
visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward
normal. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered,
with no repeated or duplicate billing.
At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue home exercises and
return if symptoms recurred or worsened.
